subject: ADR-173: the field notebook's outputs, read -- the .eco lines and the CSV byte for byte, the print held -- and the notebook gets a suite
body: THE ONE DATA-ENTRY PAGE WITH A TASK AND NO SUITE. audit_outputs listed field-notebook next after the experiment guide: three exports (Copy .eco lines, Copy CSV, Print / save PDF), none read. Looking for the suite to pin the literals in -- ADR-172's rule, the page's own suite states what the export must be from the grammar and holds the task to it -- turned up that there was none: every other data-entry page has a verify_<page>, and the notebook's Shannon, Morisita and Lincoln-Petersen figures were held only by the task, to literals a reader was asked to check by hand. The task, in the state ADR-165 leaves the page in, presses every export and holds what left: Copy .eco lines -> one clipboard payload held BYTE FOR BYTE (the two comment lines, data: focal forage=4 preen=2, data: site species-a=6 species-b=3 clover=1, the quadrat comment, model: markrecapture 5 4 2, the note); Copy CSV -> one clipboard payload held whole, fifteen rows under section,item,count, and the site, which carries a comma, comes out QUOTED so a spreadsheet reads one field and not two -- the one claim on this page a reader could not check by looking at the screen; Print / save PDF -> exactly one payload, a print; then the counters and the .eco box read once more, unchanged. tools/verify/verify_fn.py (new, 21 checks) drives the notebook to the same state through its own controls and holds, from formulas stated independently of the page's JavaScript, Shannon, Pielou, Hill N1, the quadrats' variance/mean and Morisita, the clumped reading, and Lincoln-Petersen N = M*C/R with the R = 0 case saying undefined in words; then the .eco from the grammar, the CSV from RFC 4180 and the print counted once; then the TASK's literals held to those same statements -- Q4,9 -> Q4,8 in the task fails the suite. field-notebook 0 -> 3 OF 3 OUTPUTS HELD, ceiling 3 -> 0; the kit's unread outputs 18 -> 15 of 66; the task 80 -> 95 confirmed, 0 refuted; the kit 75 -> 76 suites. Held: the task enters the date, so both exports are deterministic and held whole; each tap of a holdable button counts one. No page was edited -- a task, a new suite, and the ledger; nine pages still hand something over unread.
